_comment: Copy this file to places.json. Every field except path is optional. JSON has no comments, so the notes live in these _comment keys, which are ignored.
name: shown in the list; taken from the last path segment if left out
group: optional heading, shown before the name and searchable as context
path: the only required field -- see the path shapes below
open: explorer | default | code | notepad++ | terminal -- what Enter does; omit for the default worked out from the path

_comment: A folder. With no opener named, Enter opens it in Explorer.
name: Maven repo

_comment: A file with no extension. Enter opens it in Notepad++ as administrator -- without elevate, editing hosts appears to work and then fails on save.
name: hosts

_comment: A project folder that should open in the editor rather than Explorer.
name: quick-tools

_comment: A .pdf, or anything else with an extension, goes to whatever Windows has registered for it.
name: Handbook

_comment: Path shapes. All of these resolve to the same place, so a path can be pasted from wherever it was copied rather than corrected by hand.
name: backslashes
doubled separators, from an over-escaped string literal
a leading ~ for the home directory
